lines.said: P equals P nought E to the power K T. It starts at one hundred and doubles every seven point five hours. Find K.

lines.heard: He is involved. So take LN of both sides.
lines.said: E is involved, so take L N of both sides.

lines.heard: LN cancels E leaving the power. 7.5k equals LN2.
lines.said: L N cancels E, leaving the power. Seven point five K equals L N two.

lines.heard: So K equals ln2 over 7.5 about 0.0924.
lines.said: So K equals L N two over seven point five, about zero point zero nine two four.
